question: What final placement should the wise practitioner perform in the body?
premises: Jīva and prāṇa form a pair.
They are to be placed in the whole body.
The wise practitioner performs this act.
inference: The wise one should thus place the pair of jīva and prāṇa throughout the whole body.
plain_english: Thus the wise one should place the pair, jīva and prāṇa, in the whole body.
